specs.name: dist_trail_m
specs.source: Jacobs 2015 p. 13: uninjured trail PDEN 8+-1 at 20 m cumulative offset, 5.5+-0.5 at 40 m; Table 1 p. 28: trails 5x uninjured, 7x injured. Trail data: OSM + USFS (Jacobs); here OSM.

specs.name: dist_road_m
specs.source: Jacobs 2015 p. 13: uninjured road PDEN 4.5+-0.4 at 20 m, 3+-0.2 within 40 m; injured 1.5+-0.3 at 40 m (p = .02). Table 1 p. 28: roads 3x uninjured, 1.5x injured.

specs.name: dist_stream_m
specs.source: Jacobs 2015 p. 18: uninjured stream PDEN 2.2+-0.3 at 40 m track offset, 1.8+-0.2 at 80 m; injured 3.4+-0.4 at 80 m. Table 1 p. 28: streams 2x uninjured, 3.5x injured.

hiker.source: Koester 2008, Lost Person Behavior, hiker distance table, Dry/Flat row (n=58), book page unverified; as reproduced in Sava et al. 2016 Table 1 p. 8 and Ferguson IGT4SAR IPP_EuclideanDistance2.py. Converted from miles.
